methodology.description: Fundamentals-only score; the Sep 16 expanded sweep refreshed market prices, position values, unrealised P/L and action levels without mechanically changing business-quality ratings. Quantities and average costs come from the user's Rakuten snapshot; prices are the latest verified Sep 15–16 observations. USD and MYR totals remain separate and 6742UW is unpriced until its exact terms are verified.

holdings.name: ExxonMobil
holdings.status: Best fundamental anchor · hold, don't chase oil spike
metrics: 1.6286 shares · latest $169.32 · value $275.75 · transferred cost basis unavailable
Q2 operating cash flow: $23.6B
Watch: $164–166 now support · ~$176.4 breakout; no chase into geopolitical premium
holdings.strength: Strong integrated cash generation, advantaged upstream assets and refining exposure make XOM a higher-quality way to own the current energy scarcity regime.
holdings.weakness: War-premium crude is self-limiting if demand destruction or de-escalation arrives; do not treat every oil spike as permanent.
holdings.verdict: CORE HOLD / NO CHASE. The $164–166 reclaim has occurred; add only after post-Fed stability or a controlled retest, not into the oil shock.
